ai-technology.quote: AI debt financing is on an insane trajectory, per @SemiAnalysis_:
The AI boom is just not sustainable; Apollo’s Torsten Slok joins the chorus.

⚠️ Wow. The Treasury Department reportedly knows that the massive GenAI build out poses systemic risks to the US financial system – and doesn’t want to acknowledge it publicly.  

People may talk about this moment for years.

If that happens, where does it leave Anthropic and OpenAI? 

And Oracle, CoreWeave, Nebius, xAI, etc?
GenAI isn’t good enough to replace millions of employees, so there is basically no way the capex is going to earn out.
